FACT: Multiple times in this session, Ned interrupted mid-fix with 'can you first explore before fixing' and 'dude explore before fixing'. When a bug isn't obvious, he wants investigation before code changes.

CONTEXT: This happened when the Always Allow button wasn't working — assistant assumed it was a dev server restart issue without checking if the button was even rendering.

AFFECTS: For non-obvious bugs, always do at least a quick read/grep of the relevant component + check browser state before proposing a fix. Don't assume the cause from the symptom alone.
